mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.statisticsGiveLocgovByMonth */ SELECT MONTH(STTEMNT_PAY_DE) AS CNTR_MONTH ,GC.cntr_locgov_code AS LOCGOV_CODE ,IFNULL(COUNT(GC.USER_ID), 0) AS CNTR_CNT ,IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT(USER_ID)), 0) AS CNTR_PERSON ,IFNULL(SUM(GC.CNTR_AMT), 0) AS CNTR_AMT ,IFNULL(COUNT(CASE WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE = '100' THEN 1 END), 0) AS CNTR_ONLINE ,IFNULL(COUNT(CASE WHEN CNTR_PATH_CODE IN ('200', '300') THEN 1 END), 0) AS CNTR_OFFLINE FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE YEAR(STTEMNT_PAY_DE) = #{shCntrYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CNTR_MONTH, GC.cntr_locgov_code

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.statisticsGiveLocgovByAge */ SELECT GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ,(CASE WHEN AGE < 20 THEN '10' WHEN AGE >= 70 THEN '70' ELSE TRUNC(AGE/10,0) * 10||'' END) AS CNTR_AGE ,COUNT(USER_ID) AS CNTR_CNT ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS CNTR_AMT FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NOW(), TO_DATE(CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OUD.BIRTHDAY , '', 0),'YYYYMMDD'))/12, 0) AS AGE ,GC.USER_ID ,GC.CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR GC, OP_USER OU, OP_USER_DETAIL OUD WHERE GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND OU.USER_ID = OUD.USER_ID AND YEAR(STTEMNT_PAY_DE) = #{shCntrYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND OUD.BIRTHDAY IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_AGE

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.statisticsGiveLocgovByHour */ SELECT GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ,HOUR(GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) AS CNTR_HOUR ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE 1 = 1 AND CNTR_DE = #{shCntrDate} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_HOUR

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGivePersonStatisticsDetail */ SELECT DT AS CNTR_MONTH ,GIVE_PERSONS ,(CASE WHEN GIVE_ALL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(GIVE_PERSONS * 1.0/GIVE_ALL * 100,1)) ELSE 0 END) AS PERCENT FROM ( SELECT GY.DT ,COUNT(DISTINCT(USER_ID)) AS GIVE_PERSONS ,SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID)) OVER() as GIVE_ALL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(A.SETMONTH, LEVEL -1), 'YYYYMM') AS DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{fromYear}||'01','YYYYMM') AS SETMONTH ) A CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (#{toYear} - #{fromYear} + 1) * 12 ) GY LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR GC ON GY.DT = SUBSTRING(GC.CNTR_DE,1,6) AND YEAR(GC.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN #{fromYear} AND #{toYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} GROUP BY GY.DT ) A

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGivePersonStatisticsDetailByDate */ SELECT DAY(DT) AS CNTR_DATE ,GIVE_PERSONS ,(CASE WHEN GIVE_ALL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(GIVE_PERSONS * 1.0/GIVE_ALL * 100,1)) ELSE 0 END) AS PERCENT FROM ( SELECT DT ,COUNT(DISTINCT GC.USER_ID) AS GIVE_PERSONS ,SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID)) OVER() AS GIVE_ALL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADDDATE(A.SETMONTH, LEVEL -1), 'YYYYMMDD') AS DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{cntrMonth},'YYYYMM') AS SETMONTH ) A CONNECT BY LEVEL <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(A.SETMONTH)) ) GD LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR GC ON GD.DT = GC.CNTR_DE AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING(GC.CNTR_DE,1,6) = #{cntrMonth} AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DT ) A

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGivePersonStatisticsDetailExcel */ SELECT CNTR_DE ,COUNT(DISTINCT(USER_ID)) AS GIVE_PERSONS ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS GIVE_AMT ,COUNT(USER_ID) AS GIVE_CNT FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(GC.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN #{fromYear} AND #{toYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} GROUP BY CNTR_DE

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGiveAmountStatisticsDetail */ SELECT DT AS CNTR_MONTH ,GIVE_AMT ,(CASE WHEN GIVE_ALL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(GIVE_AMT * 1.0/GIVE_ALL * 100,1)) ELSE 0 END) AS PERCENT FROM ( SELECT GY.DT ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS GIVE_AMT ,SUM(SUM(CNTR_AMT)) OVER() as GIVE_ALL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(A.SETMONTH, LEVEL -1), 'YYYYMM') AS DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{fromYear}||'01','YYYYMM') AS SETMONTH ) A CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (#{toYear} - #{fromYear} + 1) * 12 ) GY LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR GC ON GY.DT = SUBSTRING(GC.CNTR_DE,1,6) AND YEAR(GC.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN #{fromYear} AND #{toYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} GROUP BY GY.DT ) A

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGiveAmountStatisticsDetailByDate */ SELECT DAY(DT) AS CNTR_DATE ,GIVE_AMT ,(CASE WHEN GIVE_ALL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(GIVE_AMT * 1.0/GIVE_ALL * 100,1)) ELSE 0 END) AS PERCENT FROM ( SELECT DT ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS GIVE_AMT ,SUM(SUM(CNTR_AMT)) OVER() AS GIVE_ALL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADDDATE(A.SETMONTH, LEVEL -1), 'YYYYMMDD') AS DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{cntrMonth},'YYYYMM') AS SETMONTH ) A CONNECT BY LEVEL <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(A.SETMONTH)) ) GD LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR GC ON GD.DT = GC.CNTR_DE AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING(GC.CNTR_DE,1,6) = #{cntrMonth} AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DT ) A

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGiveNumberStatisticsDetail */ SELECT DT AS CNTR_MONTH ,GIVE_CNT ,(CASE WHEN GIVE_ALL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(GIVE_CNT * 1.0/GIVE_ALL * 100,1)) ELSE 0 END) AS PERCENT FROM ( SELECT GY.DT ,COUNT(USER_ID) AS GIVE_CNT ,SUM(COUNT(USER_ID)) OVER() AS GIVE_ALL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(A.SETMONTH, LEVEL -1), 'YYYYMM') AS DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{fromYear}||'01','YYYYMM') AS SETMONTH ) A CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (#{toYear} - #{fromYear} + 1) * 12 ) GY LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR GC ON GY.DT = SUBSTRING(GC.CNTR_DE,1,6) AND YEAR(GC.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN #{fromYear} AND #{toYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} GROUP BY GY.DT ) A

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGiveNumberStatisticsDetailByDate */ SELECT DAY(DT) AS CNTR_DATE ,GIVE_CNT ,(CASE WHEN GIVE_ALL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(GIVE_CNT * 1.0/GIVE_ALL * 100,1)) ELSE 0 END) AS PERCENT FROM ( SELECT DT ,COUNT(USER_ID) AS GIVE_CNT ,SUM(COUNT(USER_ID)) OVER() AS GIVE_ALL FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADDDATE(A.SETMONTH, LEVEL -1), 'YYYYMMDD') AS DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{cntrMonth},'YYYYMM') AS SETMONTH ) A CONNECT BY LEVEL <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(A.SETMONTH)) ) GD LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR GC ON GD.DT = GC.CNTR_DE AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING(GC.CNTR_DE,1,6) = #{cntrMonth} AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DT ) A

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGiveDateStatisticsDetailByDate */ SELECT GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO ,GC.CNTR_AMT ,GC.CNTR_POINT ,(SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC WHERE ID = GC.CNTR_PATH_CODE AND CODE_TYPE = 'CNTR_PATH' AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS CNTR_PATH_NAME FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE 1=1 AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} AND GC.CNTR_DE = #{shCntrDeStart} ORDER BY GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGivePersonalStatisticsDetailTotal */ SELECT SUM(B.GIVE_CNT) AS GIVE_CNT ,SUM(B.GIVE_AMT) AS GIVE_AMT ,SUM(B.GIVE_POINT) AS GIVE_POINT FROM ( SELECT USER_ID ,SUM(1) AS GIVE_CNT ,SUM(CNTR_AMT) AS GIVE_AMT ,SUM(CNTR_POINT) AS GIVE_POINT FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(GC.CNTR_DE) BETWEEN #{fromYear} AND #{toYear} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} GROUP BY USER_ID ) B, OP_USER OU WHERE B.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGivePersonalStatisticsDetailByUser */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(GC.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS STTEMNT_PAY_DE ,GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO ,GC.CNTR_AMT as GIVE_AMT ,GC.CNTR_POINT as GIVE_POINT ,(SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC WHERE ID = GC.CNTR_PATH_CODE AND CODE_TYPE = 'CNTR_PATH' AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS CNTR_PATH_NAME FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE 1=1 AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} AND GC.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY STTEMNT_PAY_DE DESC

/* saleson.shop.give.statistics.GiveStatisticsMapper.getGiveOperateListByLocgov */ SELECT NVL(CNTR_YEAR,0) AS CNTR_YEAR ,AMT_100 ,CNT_100 ,AMT_200 ,CNT_200 ,AMT_300 ,CNT_300 ,AMT_400 ,CNT_400 ,NVL(AMT_100 + AMT_200 + AMT_300 + AMT_400, 0) AS EXPNDTR_SUM ,NVL(CNT_100 + CNT_200 + CNT_300 + CNT_400, 0) AS EXPNDTR_CNT FROM ( SELECT YEAR(GCO.EXPNDTR_DE) AS CNTR_YEAR ,NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '100' THEN GCO.EXPNDTR_AMT END),0) AS AMT_100 ,NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '100' THEN 1 END),0) AS CNT_100 ,NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '200' THEN GCO.EXPNDTR_AMT END),0) AS AMT_200 ,NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '200' THEN 1 END),0) AS CNT_200 ,NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '300' THEN GCO.EXPNDTR_AMT END),0) AS AMT_300 ,NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '300' THEN 1 END),0) AS CNT_300 ,NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '400' THEN GCO.EXPNDTR_AMT END),0) AS AMT_400 ,NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN GCO.BSNS_PURPS_CODE = '400' THEN 1 END),0) AS CNT_400 FROM G_CTBNY_OPRATN GCO WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} GROUP BY YEAR(GCO.EXPNDTR_DE) WITH ROLLUP ) ORDER BY CNTR_YEAR DESC
